displayName.ja: 【断てぬ想い】 林崎　宮子

profile.ja:
相手の意思を断つ特殊な忍法『心遁・意想一断』を使う学生対魔忍。
代々自身の心を操る忍法を発現する家系だが、宮子は他人の精神に干渉する術を使う。
刀で相手の身体を切る時に発動し、肉体に傷を与える代わりに敵対心・反抗心を断つ事ができ、その強さは与えるはずだった傷の深さに比例し、浅手ならば意志を鈍らせ、命を絶つほどの深手ならば、無抵抗にこちらの要求を受け入れる様になる。
家族との関係から人を遠ざけがちだが、根は素直で優しい性格で、後で悪い事をしたと気を揉む事も多い。
自身が強くなれば家族にも堂々と接する事ができるのではと思い、訓練や授業はサボらず出席している。
誰にでも無愛想に接してしまう宮子は自分が恋愛する事などないと考えている。
ただ、ジューンブライドの時期に周囲の女子達が盛り上がるのを聞くと、つい自分の場合を想像してしまう。
すぐにそんな自分の想像を「ありえないし」と否定する宮子だが、その頬は少し赤く染まっていた。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin who uses a special ninja technique called "Shin Ton - Iso Kagiri" that can cut off her opponent's will. Her family has a history of possessing ninja techniques that allow them to control their own minds, but Miyako's technique is different, allowing her to interfere with other people's spirits. Her technique is activated when she cuts her opponent's body with her sword, dealing physical damage in exchange for cutting off their will to fight. The strength of the technique is proportional to the depth of the wound, and it can be used to capture enemies alive or make them more susceptible to interrogation. Miyako tends to distance herself from people due to her family dynamics, but she is actually a straightforward and kind person who often reflects on her actions. She attends training and classes without fail, hoping to become stronger and be able to interact with her family with confidence. She doesn't think she'll ever fall in love, but when she hears about the excitement surrounding June weddings, she can't help but imagine what it would be like.

text.ja: ……なに？　あぁ、この格好？　まぁ……花嫁衣装だね。こんな格好でも仕事はしっかりするから……安心して
text.en: ...What's up? This outfit? It's just a wedding dress... don't worry, I can still do my job...

text.ja: 私が……花嫁。ありえないって……なにがどうなればそうなるわけ？　私なんて結婚どころか、恋愛だって……。でも、ドレスは可愛いかも
text.en: Me, a bride? That's impossible... what would it take for that to happen? I'm not even capable of romance, let alone marriage... but the dress is kind of cute...

text.ja: ウェディングドレスってこんなに肌が見えてるもん？　特に下が……スースーするというか。……あんまり見ないでくれる？　恥ずかしいから
text.en: Is a wedding dress supposed to show this much skin? Especially the bottom... it's a bit see-through... can you not look at me too much? It's embarrassing...

text.ja: あんたはその……結婚願望とかあるの？　いや、聞いてみただけだって……。結婚って、みんなしたいものなのかな……って思ってさ
text.en: Do you have any desire to get married? Not that I'm asking for any particular reason... I just wonder if it's something that everyone wants...

text.ja: に、似合ってるって？　いいって……別にお世辞とか言わなくて。違うの？　そう……。褒め言葉として……受け取っていいんだよね？
text.en: You think I look good in this? It's okay, you don't have to give me empty compliments... is that what you meant? I can take it as a genuine compliment, right?

text.ja: このブーケの花……綺麗。これって確か……投げるんだっけ？　それで拾った人が次に結婚できるっていう。誰か欲しい人いるかな……
text.en: These flowers in the bouquet are beautiful... I think you're supposed to throw them, and whoever catches them is the next to get married... is there anyone who wants to catch them?

text.ja: 恋愛とかよくわかんないけど……羨ましくはあるのかも。……そんな人生が変わっちゃう経験を、してみたいような……したくないような
text.en: I don't really understand romance, but... I do feel a bit envious... it's like I want to experience that kind of life-changing event, but at the same time, I don't...

text.ja: ジューンブライドか……結婚する月とか気にするんだ。私は……何月でもいいと思うけど。……って、そんなの考えてどうすんの。らしくない
text.en: June weddings, huh... people make a big deal about getting married in June... I think any month is fine, though... what's the point of even thinking about that, anyway? It's not like me...

text.ja: こんな格好をしてるから？　んあぐぅう！　はぁはぁ……オマンコが熱くて熱くてたまらないっ。んぅうう！　収まってよっ、んぁああっ！
text.en: Is it because I'm dressed like this? Nnng, uuuuh! Haah, haah... my pussy is so hot... uuuuh! Calm down, haah...

text.ja: 花嫁だから……結婚初夜ってわけ？　でも……んぅう！　はぁはぁ、恥ずかしいっ！　ドレス着たままセックスなんて……くっ、んぅううっ
text.en: Just because I'm a bride... does that mean it's like a wedding night? But... uuuuh! Haah, haah, it's so embarrassing! Having sex in a wedding dress... uuuuh!

text.ja: おっぱい……触りすぎだって。んはぁっ……ストッキングだって好き勝手に破いてるし。ここまでしたんだから……最後までしてよね
text.en: My breasts... you're touching them too much. Haa... and you're tearing my stockings apart as you please. Since we've gone this far... see it through to the end, okay?
